title: Derive VALID_AGENT_NAMES from system-map.json at build/test time (SSOT-derive)
context: This is the 4th string-vs-enum mismatch bug (after VNH DomainType, commit-mutex, verified_decision). Each was caused by a hardcoded enum drifting from the canonical roster in docs/data/system-map.json. The XS fix (BOOTSTRAP-ENUM-BCTC) adds 'bctc-analyst' manually; the durable fix is to derive VALID_AGENT_NAMES from the SSOT so new cowork agents auto-propagate.

proposed_fix.approach: At build/test time, read docs/data/system-map.json and emit a generated TypeScript const for VALID_AGENT_NAMES. Options: (a) a bun script run in prebuild that writes getCycleBootstrap.generated.ts, (b) a Zod enum built at test-init from the JSON, (c) keep the const but add a CI assertion that compares it against the JSON roster.
proposed_fix.preferred: Option (c) — CI assertion — is lowest risk: the existing guard test (1975-bootstrap-enum-bctc-analyst-guard.test.ts) already does this at test time. Promote it to a mandatory gate in the bun test suite.
proposed_fix.risk_if_done_in_xs: Full runtime-derive requires infra file I/O in the application layer (layer violation) or a build-time codegen step (new tooling). Both exceed XS scope. SPIKE required.

proposed_spike.priority: medium — guard test partially mitigates until spike ships
